papers.markingGuideNote: The scheme awards attempt marks of 2 for a 5-mark step. Deduct 3 for a mathematical error, or 1 for a numerical slip or minor misreading. A serious error that oversimplifies the task receives attempt marks only. Valid alternative methods are accepted. Do not deduct an error twice.
papers.boundaryReview: Q5(a) v and e receive 10 each. Q8(b) the moment of inertia receives 20, centre of gravity 5 and turning angle 5. Q9(b) mercury depth receives 20 and oil volume 10. Q2(a) magnitude and direction share one final 5-mark placement. Q3(a)(i) the two angles share one final 5-mark placement, whereas Q3(a)(ii) each flight time has its own 5 marks. The official correction says the latter asks for the ground, not P, and awards the last 5 marks to all candidates with work in that part; this note accompanies both time tasks. Q4(b)(i) the force diagrams receive 5 each. Q6(b)(ii) maximum and minimum tension have separate 5-mark placements. Q7(a) Q receives the shared resolution/moment work plus its own result (20); P has a separate 5. Q10(a)(ii) time and distance receive 5 each. No finite answer-option pools occur.
